title: Explicit finite-evaluation endpoints for the system projection
statement: For the normalized integral datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], define TensorComparison to be a natural isomorphism from the uncurried integral tensor followed by finite reduction to the finite partial tensor of the two reduced inputs. Its components give TensorCoordinates of [def-sf-integral-projection-reduction-coordinates]. Define evaluation and the full finite inclusion, and reductionEvaluation from the recorded coefficient calculus. Define systemSource and systemTarget to be the actual endpoints of the coefficient-system compactification projection from [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. Define properViaSupport by conjugating the actual proper counit projection with the two components of properIdentity. All maps and objects are explicit; none is chosen from a mere existence assertion.

source.place: Compatibility of the specified maps under successive coefficient reductions; integral reconstruction and proper counit normalization

proof.text: Take natural-isomorphism components, abbreviate the specified functors and system projection endpoints, and compose the tensor of properIdentity, the proper counit map and the inverse target properIdentity. The reductionEvaluation component is exactly the quotient scalar-extension comparison already recorded in the calculus.
